note: Rounds whose date span crosses a rule-version change day. A move's recorded rules_version is accepted if its rule window overlaps the round span [start, end]; rounds without an entry have span [date, date] (no span). The span is the round's true date range as recorded on the page (data.json seasons[].rounds[].date). No existing canonical-trace field expresses a round span: moves carry a single earliest-day date, seasons carry season-level dates only, so the span is recorded here explicitly. Do not change the round date to a single day. Do not move any rule effective date. Labels are the monthly round codes after the 2026-11-22 monthly rebuild (the old S5:5-1 round is now S5 2026-11).
